SEST award artwork - Makran Line

Code-drawn strips (integration/campaign/service_awards.py). No AI imagery;
nothing traced. Real-award strips follow the published stripe order and
proportions closely enough to be recognised; they are representations.
  sest_makran_line_service.png - Makran Line Service Ribbon: fictional SEST design
  sest_arabian_sea_security.png - Arabian Sea Security Ribbon: fictional SEST design
  sest_trailing_operations.png - Trailing Operations Ribbon: fictional SEST design

Commander emblem in ui/campaign/navy_emblems/, scaled by build_pack.py from the SEST
gallery flag set (Wikimedia Commons, public domain; credited in Gallery/VISUAL_CREDITS.txt):
  sest_pakn_emblem.png - Pakistan Navy: the national flag of Pakistan. The Pakistan
    Navy's own ensign is not in the gallery set.
    Source: File:Flag of Pakistan.svg

Every real-award citation says it is a game award for a fictional operation,
not a real honour.
